scope.profile: Decoded plane surface fields; parser-fed SAB 21800 rooted projection also exercised
scope.public_api: drw_projectPointToAcisPlaneSurface orthogonally projects a finite point to the infinite plane defined by the decoded origin and normal.
scope.normal_policy: The stored normal is unchanged; a temporary unit normal is used for the geometric operation.
scope.arithmetic_policy: Scaled-coordinate and product/quotient arithmetic avoid avoidable intermediate overflow while refusing unrepresentable final coordinates.
scope.refusal_policy: Unsupported/missing plane, zero/non-finite normal, non-finite point, or unrepresentable projected coordinate returns false without changing projectedPoint.
non_claims: face UV domain or trim clipping
general analytic or NURBS surface evaluation
B-rep validity or native consumer qualification
